cohort: 41 women who underwent emergency PH at a tertiary care center between 2004 and 2016
finding: Peripartal hysterectomy is associated with increased rates of blood product transfusions and has a high morbidity with a major complication rate of more than 50%, with abnormal placentation being the leading cause.
mod_finding: 80.5% of peripartal hysterectomies followed a cesarean section.
